sentence: This project tries to find out how auxiliary proteins control the activity of ion channels and what that control looks like in structure.
This project studies how B lymphocytes that target insulin learn to recognize insulin as type 1 diabetes progresses.
This project studies how a gene regulatory network works in glioblastoma cells, which come from a tumor of the central nervous system.
This project builds computational methods to find shared genetic causes and gene networks behind neuropsychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia and autism spectrum disorders.
This project studies how the setting and timing of signaling pathways lead to correct patterns of gene expression during development.
This project builds models that use genetic risk scores together with social and environmental factors to predict which youth start using cannabis early.
This project studies how muscle, endothelial and immune cells interact in human skeletal muscles, using single-nucleus and spatial transcriptomics.
This project studies how compounds found in botanicals can suppress inflammation and looks for pathways that trigger or prevent inflammation.
This project studies how cadherin-11 affects macrophages and fibroblasts as lung fibrosis develops and whether targeting it with nanoparticles can treat fibrosis.
This project studies how hypertension, obesity and diabetes before pregnancy link to preeclampsia and to later cardiovascular disease.
This project studies how variety in the major histocompatibility complex and immune cell receptors shapes spondyloarthritis and acute anterior uveitis.
This project builds a portable retinal imaging system on a smartphone that uses machine learning to detect diabetic retinopathy.
This project builds a genetic screen in which cells with different mutations compete within an embryo, and uses it to study genes in the eye.
This project builds a detailed model of the mRNA export platform of the nuclear pore complex and tests how mutations linked to aging disrupt it.
This project uses machine learning to predict and design how T cell receptors recognize tumor antigens, using large datasets of matched pairs.
This project makes and supplies viral vectors that let researchers manipulate and trace cells in the retina and brain.
This project studies how lymphoma develops and how changing metabolism weakens survival signals in B-cell lymphoma.
This project builds chemical tools that label, track and control messenger RNAs in the cell to study how drugs and metabolites interact with them.
This project tries to predict how much alkylated contamination builds up in crayfish and shellfish from concentrations measured in the surrounding water.
This project coordinates communication, reports, data management and statistical support for a group of research projects and shared cores.
